title: This adds an option --keys-from-stdin-sizes to the "cryptsetup reencrypt" command line.
description:
This adds an option --keys-from-stdin-sizes to the "cryptsetup reencrypt" command line.

This adds support for reencrypting LUKS2 volumes that have multiple keyslots with binary passphrases of different sizes.

Other cryptsetup features and commands are not affected.

+Description: reencrypt: add option --keys-from-stdin-sizes
+ This option enables reencryption of LUKS2 volumes with multiple passphrases
+ with arbitrary characters and sizes, while retaining all keyslots.
+Author: Frederic Hoerni <frederic.hoerni@canonical.com>
+Origin: backport
+Bug: https://gitlab.com/cryptsetup/cryptsetup/-/merge_requests/958
+Forwarded: https://gitlab.com/cryptsetup/cryptsetup/-/merge_requests/958
+Last-Update: 2026-09-23
+---
+This patch header follows DEP-3: https://dep-team.pages.debian.net/deps/dep3//
+diff --git a/man/common_options.adoc b/man/common_options.adoc
+index 0b00cb6e..d236e8b2 100644
+--- a/man/common_options.adoc
++++ b/man/common_options.adoc
+@@ -501,6 +501,16 @@ This option is useful to cut trailing newlines, for example.
+ If --keyfile-offset is also given, the size count starts after the offset.
+ endif::[]
+ 
++ifdef::ACTION_REENCRYPT[]
++*--keys-from-stdin-sizes* _<list of sizes>_ (LUKS2 only)::
++The passphrases are read from stdin when reencrypting, and this options gives their sizes. It shall be a comma-separated list of integers (in base 10).
++There must be as many sizes provided as there are keyslots in the LUKS header. The passphrases must be given on stdin in the order of their keyslot index (without '\n' separators).
+++
++This option is useful when there are several passphrases of different sizes that are made of random bytes and may contain newline characters.
+++
++This option cannot be combined with --key-file, --keyfile-offset, --keyfile-size or --key-slot options.
++endif::[]
++
+ ifdef::ACTION_OPEN,ACTION_LUKSFORMAT,ACTION_REENCRYPT,ACTION_BENCHMARK,ACTION_LUKSADDKEY[]
+ *--key-size*, *-s* _bits_::
+ ifndef::ACTION_LUKSADDKEY,ACTION_REENCRYPT[]

+index 83fac42c..33f87c28 100644
+--- a/man/cryptsetup-reencrypt.8.adoc
++++ b/man/cryptsetup-reencrypt.8.adoc
+@@ -64,6 +64,7 @@ Note that for encrypt and decrypt mode, the whole device must be treated as unen
+ --key-slot,
+ --keyfile-offset,
+ --keyfile-size,
++--keys-from-stdin-sizes,
+ --tries,
+ --timeout,
+ --pbkdf,
+@@ -155,6 +156,10 @@ All other keyslots will be removed after the reencryption finishes.
+ 
+ *cryptsetup reencrypt --token-type systemd-tpm2 /dev/encrypted_device*
+ 
++Reencrypt LUKS2 device with 2 keyslots (with passphrases "pass1" and "pass2222"):
++
++*echo "pass1pass2222" | cryptsetup reencrypt --keys-from-stdin-sizes 5,8 /dev/encrypted_device*
++
+ === LUKS2 DECRYPTION EXAMPLES
+ 
+ Decrypt LUKS2 device with header put in the head of the data device (header file does not exist):

+index 94d6dce9..1388ea26 100644
+--- a/src/cryptsetup.c
++++ b/src/cryptsetup.c
+@@ -3412,6 +3412,21 @@ static const char *verify_reencrypt(void)
+ 	if (ARG_SET(OPT_NEW_VOLUME_KEY_KEYRING_ID) && ARG_SET(OPT_KEEP_KEY_ID))
+ 		return _("Options --new-volume-key-keyring and --keep-key cannot be combined.");
+ 
++	if (isLUKS1(luksType(device_type)) && ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID))
++		return _("Option --keys-from-stdin-sizes can be set only for LUKS2 device.");
++
++	if (ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID) && ARG_SET(OPT_KEY_FILE_ID))
++		return _("Options --keys-from-stdin-sizes and --key-file cannot be combined");
++
++	if (ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID) && ARG_SET(OPT_KEYFILE_OFFSET_ID))
++		return _("Options --keys-from-stdin-sizes and --keyfile-offset cannot be combined");
++
++	if (ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID) && ARG_SET(OPT_KEYFILE_SIZE_ID))
++		return _("Options --keys-from-stdin-sizes and --keyfile-size cannot be combined");
++
++	if (ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID) && ARG_SET(OPT_KEY_SLOT_ID))
++		return _("Options --keys-from-stdin-sizes and --key-slot cannot be combined");
++
+ 	return NULL;
+ }
+ 
+@@ -3796,6 +3811,13 @@ static void basic_options_cb(poptContext popt_context,
+ 			usage(popt_context, EXIT_FAILURE, _("Invalid maximal tries specification."),
+ 			      poptGetInvocationName(popt_context));
+ 		break;
++	case OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID:
++		if (!verify_keys_from_stdin_sizes(ARG_STR(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID))) {
++			usage(popt_context, EXIT_FAILURE,
++			_("Option --keys-from-stdin-sizes must be a list of integers separated by comma(s)"),
++			poptGetInvocationName(popt_context));
++		}
++		break;
+ 	}
+ }

+diff --git a/src/cryptsetup_args.h b/src/cryptsetup_args.h
+index 696cbd14..4e165ae3 100644
+--- a/src/cryptsetup_args.h
++++ b/src/cryptsetup_args.h

+ #define OPT_LUKS2_METADATA_SIZE_ACTIONS		{ REENCRYPT_ACTION, FORMAT_ACTION }

+ #define OPT_NEW_KEYFILE_ACTIONS			{ ADDKEY_ACTION }
+ #define OPT_NEW_KEY_DESCRIPTION_ACTIONS		{ ADDKEY_ACTION }

+index 677bd9da..811d884d 100644
+--- a/src/utils_arg_names.h
++++ b/src/utils_arg_names.h
+@@ -93,6 +93,7 @@
+ #define OPT_KEY_SLOT			"key-slot"
+ #define OPT_KEYFILE_OFFSET		"keyfile-offset"
+ #define OPT_KEYFILE_SIZE		"keyfile-size"
++#define OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES	"keys-from-stdin-sizes"
+ #define OPT_KEYSLOT_CIPHER		"keyslot-cipher"
+ #define OPT_KEYSLOT_KEY_SIZE		"keyslot-key-size"

+diff --git a/src/utils_luks.c b/src/utils_luks.c
+index 2d843294..6b8c3192 100644
+--- a/src/utils_luks.c
++++ b/src/utils_luks.c
+@@ -271,6 +271,84 @@ out:
+ 	return r;
+ }
+ 
++/* Parse a string of integers (base 10) separated by commas
++ *
++ * The result is stored in 'value'.
++ *
++ * Return value:
++ *    pointer to the next token (to '\0' if the end has been reached)
++ *    or NULL if an error occurred
++ */
++static const char *get_next_int(const char *list_of_integers, size_t *value)
++{
++	assert(list_of_integers);
++	assert(value);
++
++	if (!isdigit(list_of_integers[0])) return NULL; /* invalid first character */
++
++	char *next = NULL;
++	errno = 0; /* as recommended by the strtoul man page */
++	unsigned long ul = strtoul(list_of_integers, &next, 10);
++	if (errno) return NULL; /* overflow */
++	if (!next) return NULL;
++	if (ul > SIZE_MAX) return NULL; /* overflow */
++	*value = ul;
++
++	if (*next == '\0') {
++		/* Success and end of the string */
++		return next;
++	}
++	if (*next == ',') {
++		/* Success and more tokens expected. Skip the comma. */
++		return next+1;
++	}
++	/* Other unexpected characters */
++	return NULL;
++}
++
++/* Verify that the --keys-from-stdin-sizes option is correctly formatted
++ *
++ * Examples of valid input: "10,7,32" "10" "10,7,"
++ */
++bool verify_keys_from_stdin_sizes(const char *list_of_integers)
++{
++	const char *next = list_of_integers;
++	size_t size = 0;
++	while (1) {
++		next = get_next_int(next, &size);
++		if (!next) return false; /* error */
++		if (*next == '\0') return true; /* all tokens parsed successfully */
++	}
++}
++
++/* Get the size of the next key (passphrase) to read
++ *
++ * Return value:
++ *     If --keys-from-stdin-sizes is set, each call returns the next value in the list.
++ *     When this option is not set, or a value of the list is invalid or the end of
++ *     the list has been reached, it returns zero.
++ */
++static size_t get_keysize(void)
++{
++	static const char *keys_from_stdin_sizes = NULL;
++
++	if (ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID) && !keys_from_stdin_sizes) {
++		/* First call, initialize our static variable */
++		keys_from_stdin_sizes = ARG_STR(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID);
++	}
++
++	if (keys_from_stdin_sizes) {
++		size_t size = 0;
++		const char *next = get_next_int(keys_from_stdin_sizes, &size);
++		if (next) {
++			/* Got a valid value */
++			keys_from_stdin_sizes = next;
++			return size;
++		}
++	}
++	return 0;
++}
++
+ int luks_init_keyslot_context(struct crypt_device *cd,
+ 			      const char *msg,
+ 			      bool verify, bool pwquality,
+@@ -290,9 +368,17 @@ int luks_init_keyslot_context(struct crypt_device *cd,
+ 							  ARG_UINT32(OPT_KEYFILE_SIZE_ID),
+ 							  ARG_UINT64(OPT_KEYFILE_OFFSET_ID), r_kc);
+ 	else {
+-		r = tools_get_key(msg, &password, &passwordLen, ARG_UINT64(OPT_KEYFILE_OFFSET_ID),
+-				  ARG_UINT32(OPT_KEYFILE_SIZE_ID), ARG_STR(OPT_KEY_FILE_ID),
+-				  ARG_UINT32(OPT_TIMEOUT_ID), verify, pwquality, cd);
++
++		if (ARG_SET(OPT_KEYS_FROM_STDIN_SIZES_ID)) {
++			/* Force behaving like --key-file "-" (stdin) to ignore '\n' delimiters */
++			r = tools_get_key(msg, &password, &passwordLen, 0,
++							  get_keysize(), "-",
++							  ARG_UINT32(OPT_TIMEOUT_ID), 0, 0, cd);
++		} else {
++			r = tools_get_key(msg, &password, &passwordLen, ARG_UINT64(OPT_KEYFILE_OFFSET_ID),
++							  ARG_UINT32(OPT_KEYFILE_SIZE_ID), ARG_STR(OPT_KEY_FILE_ID),
++							  ARG_UINT32(OPT_TIMEOUT_ID), verify, pwquality, cd);
++		}
+ 		if (r < 0)
+ 			return r;
+ 		r = crypt_keyslot_context_init_by_passphrase(cd, password, passwordLen, r_kc);
+diff --git a/src/utils_luks.h b/src/utils_luks.h
+index 0eb7fb80..5a314340 100644
+--- a/src/utils_luks.h
++++ b/src/utils_luks.h
+@@ -68,4 +68,6 @@ int luks_init_keyslot_contexts_by_volume_keys(struct crypt_device *cd,
+ 
+ void luks_check_keyslots(struct crypt_device *cd, const char *device);
+ 
++bool verify_keys_from_stdin_sizes(const char *list_of_integers);
++
+ #endif /* UTILS_LUKS_H */

+index 793ecf6d..2d993d2a 100755
+--- a/tests/compat-args-test
++++ b/tests/compat-args-test

+ exp_pass reencrypt DEV --key-size 32

++exp_fail reencrypt DEV --keys-from-stdin-sizes -32

++exp_fail reencrypt DEV --keys-from-stdin-sizes 1,8 --keyfile-offset 16384
++exp_fail reencrypt DEV --keys-from-stdin-sizes 1,8 --key-slot 0
+ exp_pass luksFormat DEV --key-size 32
+ exp_fail luksFormat DEV --key-size 31
+ exp_fail luksFormat DEV --key-size -32
+diff --git a/tests/luks2-reencryption-test b/tests/luks2-reencryption-test
+index ae95124a..da4f94a4 100755
+--- a/tests/luks2-reencryption-test
++++ b/tests/luks2-reencryption-test
+@@ -38,6 +38,8 @@ PWD4="d54uVMKW-'7M"
+ PWD5="oDe{yCiZ_';_"
+ PWD6="T'E'Y_}<'9=q"
+ PWD7="UR%]T;x*w{3V"
++PWD8=$(echo -e 'abc;\n;def') # size of 9 bytes
++PWD9=$(echo -e 'a1\nb22')    # size of 6 bytes
+ 
+ DEV_LINK="reenc-test-link"
+ KEYRING="luks2_reencryption_test_kr"
+@@ -2988,6 +2990,42 @@ head -c 31 $VKEY1 | keyctl padd user $KEY_NAME_VK1 %:$KEYRING > /dev/null || fai
+ $CRYPTSETUP -q reencrypt --init-only --volume-key-keyring $KEY_NAME_VK2 --new-volume-key-keyring $KEY_NAME_VK1 $DEV <&- 2>/dev/null && fail
+ $CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -q "online-reencrypt" && fail "Failed initialization with reencryption flag"
+ 
++echo "[39] Multi-keyslot device reencryption with --keys-from-stdin-sizes"
++# Set an initial passphrase that has a '\n'
++echo -n "$PWD8" | $CRYPTSETUP -q luksFormat --type luks2 --keyfile-size 9 --key-file - --offset 32768 $FAST_PBKDF2 $DEV || fail
++
++# Add a passphrase that has a '\n'
++echo -n "$PWD8$PWD9" | $CRYPTSETUP -q luksAddKey --keyfile-size 9 --key-file - $FAST_PBKDF2 $DEV - || fail
++# Add a passphrase with a null byte (hardcoded as it cannot be achieved via a variable)
++echo -ne "${PWD8}1111\x00\x01\x02\x03999" | $CRYPTSETUP -q luksAddKey --keyfile-size 9 --key-file - $FAST_PBKDF2 $DEV - || fail
++
++# Check all 3 passphrases are valid
++echo -n "$PWD8" | $CRYPTSETUP open $DEV --key-file - --test-passphrase || fail
++echo -n "$PWD9" | $CRYPTSETUP open $DEV --key-file - --test-passphrase || fail
++echo -ne "1111\x00\x01\x02\x03999" | $CRYPTSETUP open $DEV --key-file - --test-passphrase || fail
++
++# Rencrypt --init-only / --resume-only
++(echo -n "$PWD8$PWD9"; echo -ne "1111\x00\x01\x02\x03999") | $CRYPTSETUP reencrypt --keys-from-stdin-sizes 9,6,11 $DEV -q --init-only || fail
++echo -n "$PWD8" | $CRYPTSETUP reencrypt $DEV --key-file - -q --resume-only || fail
++
++# Check all 3 passphrases are still valid after reencryption
++echo -n "$PWD8" | $CRYPTSETUP open $DEV --key-file - --test-passphrase || fail
++echo -n "$PWD9" | $CRYPTSETUP open $DEV --key-file - --test-passphrase || fail
++echo -ne "1111\x00\x01\x02\x03999" | $CRYPTSETUP open $DEV --key-file - --test-passphrase || fail
++
++# Check that all 3 keyslots have been retained
++$CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -e "3: luks2" || fail
++$CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -e "4: luks2" || fail
++$CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -e "5: luks2" || fail
++
++# Redo reencryption in one run
++(echo -n "$PWD8$PWD9"; echo -ne "1111\x00\x01\x02\x03999") | $CRYPTSETUP reencrypt --keys-from-stdin-sizes 9,6,11 $DEV -q || fail
++
++# Check that all 3 keyslots have been retained
++$CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -e "0: luks2" || fail
++$CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -e "1: luks2" || fail
++$CRYPTSETUP luksDump $DEV | grep -e "2: luks2" || fail
++
+ remove_mapping
+ cleanup_keyring
+ exit 0
